content: pmndrs postprocessing v6.39.4 verified via npm offers pre-built Effect classes such as Vignette, ChromaticAberration, Scanline, Noise, Glitch merged into fewer draw calls via internal shader-merging, better performance for many chained effects but abstracts away the exact GLSL-writing this project wants to practice. EffectComposer has no cross-pass data sharing, a real limit at scale, not relevant for three post-only passes here.
